description: One query for a list and one more per item. Fast with 3 items in development, slow with 300 in production.
Collecting many single-key requests and answering them with one query (`WHERE id = ANY($1)`).
Library (and pattern) from the GraphQL ecosystem: `load(key)` calls made in the same tick become one batch call, deduplicated and cached per request.
Fetching relations up front with a JOIN or a second query (`include` in Prisma, `with` in Drizzle) instead of lazily per item.
A cache created for one request and discarded after it, so it never serves stale or another user's data.
